dct_title_s: The history of the world : in five books. By Sir Walter Ralegh, Kt. The eleventh edition, printed from a copy revis'd by himself. To which is prefix'd, The life of the author, Newly compil'd, From Materials more ample and authentick than have yet been publish'd ; by Mr. Oldys. Also his trial, with some Additions: Together with a new and more copious index to the whole Work. In two volumes.
dct_description_sm: Published in 61 parts, the last part advertised in 'The monthly catalogue' for March 1733.
Reproduction of original from British Library.
Description based on print version record.
